SECURITY SPECIFICATION v1.0

Privacy Architecture & Data Contract

A formal breakdown of what data remains physically quarantined inside the customer host versus what metadata is approved for SaaS egress.

Data CategoryStays Inside Customer Perimeter (Tier 1)Approved for SaaS Egress (Tier 2)
System MetricsRaw 5s readings, exact byte counters, raw kernel ticks60s statistical summaries (min, max, mean, p50, p95, p99)
Application LogsRaw log strings, stack traces, unparsed error messagesNormalized pattern counts and anomaly frequency only
Sensitive CredentialsTokens, JWTs, DB passwords, API keys, Bearer authSTRICTLY FORBIDDEN (Filtered & Redacted)
User PIICustomer emails, IP addresses, SSNs, credit cardsSTRICTLY FORBIDDEN (Filtered & Redacted)
AIOps / MLIsolation Forest decision matrices, raw weightsAnomaly alert payload (score, metric name, bounds)
Pydantic Fail-Closed Contract (shared/schemas.py)
class MetricSummary(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")  # REJECTS ANY UNAPPROVED FIELD

    collector_id: str
    metric_name: str
    timestamp: datetime
    window_seconds: int = 60
    count: int
    min_val: float
    max_val: float
    mean_val: float
    p50: float
    p95: float
    p99: float
    unit: str = ""
    labels: dict[str, str] = Field(default_factory=dict)
